fields.title: Eisei Kensa oyobi Shisetsu Kaizen Kiroku (Sanitary Inspection and Facility Improvement Record)

visit.reason: Shoki karantina gōkaku ni yoru saikai zen no saikensa
visit.condition: Sōji, shōdoku oyobi kanki seibi ga kanryō shi, eisei jōtai wa kijun ni tatsushite iru
visit.treatment: Eisei shidō oyobi shisetsu kakunin no zikkō

fields.remarks: Karantina kikan ni okonawareta kaizen sagyō ga kanzen ni jisshi sareta koto ga kakunin sareta.

claims.fact: Kiroku wa eisei jōtai no kaizen to kensa gōkaku o akiraka ni shite iru.
